cubes.comment: The slab at the foot. Its unwrap is the lower half of ice_barrier.png, which lays out a box of exactly 18 x 18 x 8 starting at 0,32.
The pane. The top half of the texture is the unwrap of a 29 x 29 x 3 box starting at 0,0 - thin, wide and tall, which is what makes it read as a wall rather than a pillar.
